Girdwood Land Use Committee
                 Notice of Meeting on November 10, 2025 7PM
                              Minutes Final
Meeting will take place via Teams teleconference and in person at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd.

The following items have been submitted as agenda items for consideration at the meeting of the Girdwood Land Use Committee. A
voting member is any Girdwood Valley resident eighteen (18) years of age or older. Non-resident property owners, businesses, and
non-profit associations are allowed one (1) vote per entity. Detailed voting qualifications can be found in the rules outlined in the
Girdwood Land Use Committee Operating Principles.

The Girdwood Board of Supervisors, its committees, and subcommittees are subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in
Alaska Statute 44.62.310 and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Land Use Committee operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Agenda Item LUC 2511-01:
Land Acknowledgement: As we gather with a common intention for our GVSA this evening, LUC would like to begin by acknowledging
the stewardship of the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we reside on and the surrounding waters we depend on.
The current area of Girdwood is situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland. A necessary connection for
Alaska Native people, the landscape and waters around us served to carry their traditional ways of life; to gather here and harvest
Native foods. The community of Girdwood respects the Dena'ina and Alutiiq people, who were stewards of this land for generations.
We will continue to be stewards of this land and are grateful to be a part of this community.

7PM Call to order Ryan Hutchins-Cabibi

Agenda Item LUC 2510-07: Solid Waste Services Fee increase (Wilbanks)
It is unclear if the ordinance applies to Girdwood transfer station as the Girdwood station is not scaled. Informal input from people at the
meeting is that the cost to dump at the transfer station has not changed. There is a surcharge for “recycling”, and Girdwood is
interested in having local recycling option at the Transfer station. Wilbanks will follow up with transfer station and report back at a future
meeting.

Agenda Item LUC 2407-04 (A): Review GBOS action related to AO2025-91 Municipal STR Tax proposal. (Wingard/Burnett)
LUC voted in favor of a Letter of Objection in September.
In October, the amendments were introduced, LUC took no action. LOO recommendation remained.
GBOS voted in favor of sending Resolution of Support for STR tax with provision in amendment that the funds received in an area are
spent in that area, which is one of the amendments that has been introduced.

Disagreement between LUC and GBOS was forwarded to the Municipal Clerk, as required by both bodies.
GBOS assigned a member to write a letter explaining the GBOS position, but that has not yet been received.

Assembly postponed this topic to Nov 18 meeting. In addition to this STR tax, there is a proposal for increase in bed tax, and other are
other tax proposals under consideration. It is considered unlikely that all of those options will be approved by the Assembly for the April
ballot.

Agenda Item LUC 2407-04 (B): Review MOA proposed Registration AO 2025-115. Registration will provide information by zip code on
where STR activity is taking place. Registration would make STR legal activity in municipal code, which is not currently the case. This
would be completed just by ordinance. Item does not address several of the health and safety concerns that were originally included in
Bed and Breakfast code. Public hearing on this item is scheduled for the Assembly meeting Nov 18.

Agenda Item LUC 2507-05: Request for LUC recommendation for GBOS Resolution of Support for HLB to initiate a Site Specific Land
Use Study before any development is initiated in Girdwood. (formerly Agenda Item LUC 2406-04, closed 10.24) (Tuttle)
No action on this item.

Noted request to add the Watershed Master Plan request back on to the LUC agenda. Original Item was 2410-04.Item will be re-
numbered and added to New Business in December.

New Business:
Agenda Item LUC 2511-04: Clarification of AO2025-91 Re: Open Meetings Act, GBOS and Girdwood Committees
As of today, change to AMC regarding Girdwood Board of Supervisors clarifies that GBOS is subject to OMA unless they are meeting
solely on Community Council topic (as when they met with LUC last week). LUC is not subject to OMA, other committees’ status is less
clear. Action for LUC after this month is to determine if they want to change their current alignment with OMA or continue in the current
format.

Agenda Item LUC 2511-05: Discuss and consider recommendation re proposed AO 2025-117 Bed tax increase of 2%. This is another
option under consideration at the Assembly. This would add 2% to the Municipal Room tax that is not allocated already through code to
the 3 buckets that existing room tax supports.
